title: PhD Candidate: Museums, Collections and Society - Indigenous Heritage (1.0 FTE)
about: Leiden University's Faculty of Archaeology is recruiting a full-time PhD candidate in Museums, Collections and Society - Indigenous Heritage, within a VICI project. Applications through SuccessFactors are due 1 January 2027; the start is planned for April/May 2027.
requirements: Master's in archaeology, anthropology or a related field
Ability and enthusiasm for collaborative research with Indigenous communities

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: 'Experience with museum collections research' → 'Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis.'

'Master's in archaeology, anthropology or a related field' (doctoral research) → 'Summarize and compare scholarly materials while identifying recurring themes, methodological differences, arguments, findings, limitations, and potential research gaps.'
